# The Future of Neuromorphic and Neuroscience and Neuro AI  
# Neuroscientist-In-Exile

## Core Context
- Focuses on mathematical and algorithmic frameworks for neuromorphic computing.
- Distinguishes between biological fidelity simulation and algorithms and solvers for numerical computing solvers (e.g., PDEs).
- Focuses on time, space, and energy scaling of spiking and neuromorphic architectures.
- Describes how neuroscience can influence AI and NeuroAI
- Describes how neuroscience can influence post-Moore's Law Computing
